title: Text Generation Before Transformers — N-gram Language Models

questions.question: Early generators continued text from local word statistics but never understood it. What could they not do?
options: Produce fluent short continuations
Count word frequencies
Mark sentence boundaries
Track meaning across long context
questions.explanation: Local statistics have no memory of meaning. This lesson builds n-gram generation to motivate transformers.

questions.question: What does laplace_prob return for an unseen bigram when count=0?
options: Exactly zero
The probability of the previous word
The Kneser-Ney continuation probability
A positive smoothed probability 1/(unigram_count(prev)+vocab_size)
questions.explanation: Add-one smoothing changes the numerator from zero to one while retaining the vocabulary-sized denominator adjustment.

questions.question: What does Kneser-Ney continuation count for a word w?
options: The number of distinct preceding contexts of w divided by total distinct bigrams
The raw number of times w appears in all documents
The number of characters in w divided by vocabulary size
Only the most frequent predecessor of w
questions.explanation: unigram_contexts[w] stores distinct predecessors, and the code divides its size by total_unique_bigrams.

questions.question: How does perplexity convert the accumulated log probabilities?
options: It averages raw probabilities without taking logs
It returns exp(-total_log / total), the exponential of mean negative log probability
It counts the number of unique words in each sentence
It returns the highest next-word probability
questions.explanation: The function sums log p over predicted tokens, divides by token count, negates, and exponentiates.

questions.question: Why does sample_sentence exclude "<s>" from its candidate words?
options: The start marker is always the most probable semantic word
The model cannot store a start marker in its vocabulary
The start marker should begin the sequence, not be generated as an interior word
Excluding it forces every sentence to end at the first token
questions.explanation: The candidate list skips <s>; generation can still select </s> and then returns words between the markers.

questions.question: What failure does Laplace smoothing prevent for an unseen test bigram?
options: A document length longer than the training corpus
A token being assigned two POS tags
A duplicate sentence being sampled twice
A zero probability that would make the sentence log probability undefined
questions.explanation: Giving unseen transitions a small positive probability avoids log(0) and infinite perplexity for an otherwise evaluable sentence.
